'''Olall Da'aapp''' was an intensely friendly [[Gruvian]] tourist who traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with their companion [[Benja Da'aapp]]. The pair, both from the location [[Gruvia]], frequently visited the [[Kuat Passenger Port]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

==Biography==
Olall Da'aapp was a [[Gruvian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="PSG" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Gruvia system/Legends|Gruvia system]]</ref> location [[Gruvia]]. With their surname-sharing companion [[Benja Da'aapp]], Olall traveled on [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliners]] sight-seeing [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a tourist. The pair would often latch onto unsuspecting passers-by and made them their travel companions. A frequent location the two visited was the [[Kuat Passenger Port]] on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="PSG" />

==Personality and traits==
The extremely loud and attention-grabbing Olall and Benja did little else except travel the galaxy with their unwilling companions. The pair were intensely friendly, constantly telling the companions about all the locations they alleged to visit. Other topics discussed by the always-talking pair were the weather, travel conditions, and the loud, babbling tourist types that had suddenly filled [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Olall and Benja made their companions take their pictures, and film them as they posed in front of interesting scenes. These companions would get annoyed from their constant discussion and would be forced to watch the pair's travel [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] from their [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] for [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="PSG" />

Olall and Benja were both Gruvians, a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Species/Legends|species]] with eight [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and four spindly [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. The large [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] moved by shuffling at a worrying pace.<ref name="PSG" />

==Equipment==
The pair used three holocameras, five [[Recording rod|recording rods]], two [[Still-picture replicator|still-picture replicators]] and kept notes on their travels on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. They had two satchels with their souvenirs.<ref name="PSG" />
